routines.title: Daily Blog Publishing
runbook: Choose a fresh inclusive random target from 20 through 25.
Research nonduplicative HR outsourcing topics and create the required internal brief.
Draft, validate, humanize with the official blader/humanizer skill, and revalidate each article.
Generate and validate the approved deterministic thumbnail and metadata.
Validate links, schema, and the Next.js build.
Fetch and rebase main, stage only intended files, commit, push, and confirm the remote SHA.
Record the target, SHA, branch, files, push result, and validation outcome, then stop.

routines.title: Daily Research Publishing
runbook: Choose a fresh inclusive random target from 10 through 15.
Select a planned HR research cluster, gather at least 10 real sources, and create the required internal brief.
Draft, validate, humanize with the official blader/humanizer skill, and revalidate each article.
Generate and validate the approved deterministic thumbnail and metadata.
Validate links, schema, source traceability, and the Next.js build.
Fetch and rebase main, stage only intended files, commit, push, and confirm the remote SHA.
Record the target, SHA, branch, files, push result, and validation outcome, then stop.
